page.overview:
Who is Evanellein Lorn?

Evanellein Lorn was an Aes Sedai and a sitter of the Gray Ajah, who was also secretly of the Black Ajah.

She wore a low neckline at Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan's meeting. Elaida thought that she was too concerned with clothes and her own looks to seem a Green instead than a Gray. She was quite pretty, though not among the most beautiful of the Aes Sedai. She was tall, with a medium build, and dark brown hair which she wore in ever-changing styles and thought was one of her best features.

She worried about the size of her bottom, though her worries were all in her head. She was very concerned about whether men and women saw her as beautiful - but she was more concerned about women's opinions. She often wore the latest fashions, though only when she found them flattering. She preferred low-cut dresses, as she liked the shape of her bosom.

Evanellein is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.
